objective: User-facing 5-step checklist to take F-N12-1 v3 from $0 prep to live IBM Quantum Open Plan submission.

steps.title: Sign up for IBM Quantum Platform (free)
actions: Provide email + verify (no credit card needed for Open Plan)
steps.korea_note: KQC partnership active; no export restriction on Open Plan.

steps.title: Copy API token
actions: Open Account Settings -> API Keys (or upper-right avatar -> Account)
Click 'Generate API key' or copy the existing default token

steps.title: Save token to disk
actions: Paste token into ~/.qiskit/ibm-quantum-token.txt (single line, no quotes)

steps.title: Install Python deps
steps.note: If pip not found, install Python 3.10+ first (brew install python or system pkg).

preflight_validation.off_repo_compliance: HEXA-only repo respected; .py files live at ~/n12_v3_ibm/, never in anima repo.

user_blockers_top3.blocker: IBM Cloud / IBM Quantum Platform account creation (only user can do this; agent cannot create on behalf)
user_blockers_top3.mitigation: 5-min self-serve signup, no waitlist, no interview, no credit card.

user_blockers_top3.blocker: Open Plan queue wait variance (1 min to 24 h)
user_blockers_top3.mitigation: Submit overnight if morning slots are full; ibm_kingston is in active rotation per 2026-03-16 announcement.

user_blockers_top3.blocker: Substrate framing acceptance: SC-only baseline now, ion follow-up deferred
